detailed_company_sections.analyst_revision_read: Current guidance and recent operating signals were weighed against the real expectations bar; exact revision breadth was unavailable.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Preannounced revenue near the low end shifts the decision to gross margin and credible FY27 conversion.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Large orders convert, margins hold and FY27 guidance reassures.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Weak margin, working capital or guidance confirms poor revenue quality.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_judgment: Excluded by score and/or reversal-risk threshold.

consensus_method.disparity_definition: Composite mean absolute deviation of pass direction scores and reversal-risk estimates, expressed on a 0-100 scale.
consensus_method.lessons_review: Repeated expectation-bar, key-metric and forward-look controls applied narrowly; no new method change.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
